verdict.rationale: Workspace export is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like Asana, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party export feature, let alone one that keeps comments, attachments and audit trails. The REST API is only a building block, third-party tools like Fivetran or Skyvia are external integrations, and the AI-agent audit trail is a separate governance feature, so none of these count toward this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know that exporting my workspace preserves full history—comments, attachments, and audit trails—not just task titles
